credit: 3D models by Ubiquiti Inc., from the UniFi store product pages.
note: Every Ubiquiti product model that could be found, with where each one mounts. Rack devices were identified by measurement: a Y axis that is a near multiple of 44.45mm and a horizontal axis at 442.4mm. Everything else is placed from the store's own category, which knows better than any bounding box whether a thing goes on a ceiling or a desk, with a size check to catch the parts. Three entries were dropped as duplicates: the store publishes a second model for a few products under a slug ending --v1, with no description, no SKU and no category, and the product itself is already here with all three.
